title: Requirement lineage
description: Which id was issued for which requirement of a specification, across the revisions of that specification, kept beside the requirement manifest. It holds digests and numbers and never a word of the specification: the manifest is committed, a requirement sentence is often someone else's document, and the sentences live in a sidecar that is not. A later list is built against it so a requirement keeps its id; an id that no requirement carries is retired and never issued again (docs/adr/0006-a-requirement-keeps-its-id-across-a-revision.md).

next.description: The number the next new id is issued from (`R<next>`). Past every id the lineage has issued, retired ones included.

revisions.description: One row per revision of the specification, oldest first. A revision exists when the normalised text's digest differs from the last row's.

spec_sha256.description: Over the normalised specification text. Null for a revision adopted from a list that predates lineages, whose text was never digested.

sentence_sha256.description: One digest per sentence of the revision, in reading order (empty when adopted). What lets two revisions be compared sentence by sentence without either text.

manifest_sha256.description: Over the exact text of the manifest this revision's list was written as, which an acceptance pins by the same digest. What lets a words delta say which list it starts from: a document name and a revision number are carried by every copy of a specification. Null, or absent from a lineage made before it was recorded, when the list's manifest is unknown.

sidecar_sha256.description: Over the exact text of the sidecar this revision's list was written as: the words behind the ids. A manifest is coordinates only (an id, a section, a modality), so two lists of one shape and different sentences share its digest; this one tells them apart, and an acceptance pins the same digest (`manifest.sidecar_sha256`). Null, or absent from a lineage made before it was recorded, when the list's words are unknown.

requirements.description: Every id ever issued, live and retired. An id appears once.

retired_rev.description: The revision in which no requirement carried this id any longer. Null while it is live. A retired id is never issued again.

quotes.description: The digest of the requirement's normalised quote, appended in the revision in which it changed.
